context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 52 verified card drag-to-reorder functionality. Key findings: 1) PUT /api/cards/reorder accepts {card_ids: [...]} and returns {status: 'ok', count: N}. 2) GET /api/cards returns cards sorted by sort_order after reorder. 3) Profile page has tabs: Posts, Reels, Tarjetas, Guardados, Albums. 4) Cards tab shows stats (3 Tarjetas, 121 Vistas, 3 Publicas). 5) Ordenar button (data-testid='reorder-cards-btn') toggles to 'Listo' when active and switches to list view. 6) In reorder mode, DraggableList shows drag handles (data-testid='drag-handle-<cardId>') with GripVertical icons. 7) Three view modes work: compact (3-col), grid (2-col), list (rows). 8) Test user has 3 cards: 'Test NFC Card', 'Hacked Title', 'Test Card Navigation 245797 Edited'.
